title: 2-Player Party Arcade
description: Challenge a friend on the same screen or battle smart bots across brisk head-to-head mini-games packed with instant laughs and reflex duels.
controls: Pick a mini-game and tap your half of the screen to outplay your opponent or AI rival.

zh-CN.title: 双人同屏派对
zh-CN.description: 聚会破冰神器双人同屏派对：一部设备就能同屏互怼 PK，涵盖多款快节奏反应对抗小游戏，越玩越嗨！
zh-CN.controls: 选择喜欢的对抗玩法，点击各自半区屏幕与好友或电脑展开极速反应对决。
